events.title: The Raincoat Bridge
events.description: A soaked quilt bridge stretching over a ravine.

choices.text: Salvage loose hems (+1 scrap)
Trade fare for threads (-12 gold, +2 scraps)
Take a detour (Leave)

events.title: The Puppet Box Office
events.description: Rag puppets wait under a patchwork theatre awning.

choices.text: Perform a short act (+9 gold)
Restring the puppets (+24 gold, -2 scraps)
Applaud and move on

events.title: The Mismatched Mittens
events.description: A merchant untangling sewn pairs of mismatched mittens.

choices.text: Help untangle pairs (+1 scrap)
Trade copper for threads (-15 gold, +2 scraps)
Sell a matched pair (+18 gold, -1 scrap)

events.title: The Coil and Crow
events.description: A crow guarding a copper-coloured thread wheel.

choices.text: Chase the crow away (+6 gold)
Buy the thread coil (-20 gold, +3 scraps)
Back away slowly

events.title: The Patchwork Lighthouse
events.description: Fabric fog gathers around a dim stitched beacon.

choices.text: Gather threads in the fog (+1 scrap)
Repair the beacon (+26 gold, -2 scraps)
Pass by quietly

events.title: The Button Orchard
events.description: Brass buttons hang heavily on felt branches.

choices.text: Pick some buttons (+1 scrap)
Trade for ribbons (-14 gold, +2 scraps)
Sell the harvest (+20 gold, -1 scrap)

events.title: The Lacework Railway
events.description: A railway platform is suspended on braids of lace, its brass bell ringing in the fog.

choices.text: Mend a fraying platform braid (+1 scrap)
Buy a spool ticket (-18 gold, +2 scraps)
Board silently (Leave)

events.title: The Moonshadow Tailor
events.description: A tailor in a patched top hat fits velvet shadows beneath a button moon.

choices.text: Deliver washed cloth (+11 gold)
Trade a salvaged scrap (+19 gold, -1 scrap)
Refuse a fitting (Leave)

events.title: The Sleeping Thimble Giant
events.description: A giant sewing thimble snores beside a sewing-table hill, spilling copper shanks.

choices.text: Gather loose copper shanks (+1 scrap)
Polish the thimble (+31 gold, -2 scraps)
Tiptoe away (Leave)

events.title: The Needlefall Star
events.description: A falling star has pinned a silver needle through a midnight quilt field.

choices.text: Pocket a silver sliver (+8 gold)
Buy star-thread (-16 gold, +3 scraps)
Leave the pin shining (Leave)

events.title: The Jackdaw Stitchmarket
events.description: Button-eyed jackdaws barter embroidery in a market strung between dark branches.

choices.text: Exchange found buttons (+13 gold)
Trade a spare scrap for lace (+16 gold, -1 scrap)
Keep your purse closed (Leave)

events.title: The Dreaming Quilt Fair
events.description: Somnolent ragdolls parade under embroidered pennants and glowing stitched lanterns.

choices.text: Repair worn pennants (+2 scraps)
Auction rare trim (+24 gold, -2 scraps)
Watch the procession (Leave)

events.title: The Blackthorn Silk Inn
events.description: A round, button-eyed innkeeper hangs moth-eaten plum blankets under the candlelit silk awning.

choices.text: Patch the guest blankets (+2 scraps)
Trade a spool of buttons (spend 1 scrap; gain 18 gold)
Pass the warm inn (Leave)

events.title: The Copper Cicada Chapel
events.description: Copper cicadas with stitched wings chime from a chapel roof of oxblood velvet.

choices.text: Collect fallen copper wings (+10 gold)
Buy incense-thread spools (spend 14 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Leave the chiming chapel (Leave)

events.title: The Inkglass Puppet Barge
events.description: A plump marionette ferryman guides a quilt-sailed barge through ink-black moonlit water.

choices.text: Carry stitched letters across the river (+15 gold)
Repair the quilt sail (spend 2 scraps; gain 27 gold)
Stay on the shore (Leave)

events.title: The Wool-Wisp Observatory
events.description: An enormous brass telescope points through a ceiling of midnight-teal felt and floating wool stars.

choices.text: Gather star-lit wool offcuts (+1 scrap)
Buy three etched spools (spend 20 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Close the observatory shutters (Leave)

events.title: The Pumpkin Pincushion Stall
events.description: A grinning pumpkin-shaped pincushion displays bent silver pins beneath a moss-green canopy.

choices.text: Sort the pin jars (+2 scraps)
Trade a wound thread roll (spend 1 scrap; gain 22 gold)
Walk past the pin stall (Leave)

events.title: The Velvet Safety-Pin Gate
events.description: Two huge safety-pin towers clasp a dusty-rose fabric gate watched by sleepy ragdoll sentries.

choices.text: Gather fallen clasps (+1 scrap)
Pay for gate-thread (spend 11 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Take the outer path (Leave)

events.title: The Mothlace Clock
events.description: A stitched clock ticks beneath a guttering candle, its moth-shaped hands shedding dusty lace.

choices.text: Wind the brass bell (+1 scrap)
Buy cog-thread (-18 gold, +2 scraps)
Ignore the ticking clock (Leave)

events.title: The Buttonbone Aviary
events.description: Velvet-winged button-eyed birds hop along brass perches, hoarding shiny ribbons in their stitched nest.

choices.text: Sort fallen feathers (+11 gold)
Trade a gilded feather (+21 gold, -1 scrap)
Leave the aviary (Leave)

events.title: The Ashen Quilt Greenhouse
events.description: Needle-leaf sprouts glow through moonlit sewn glass while pale ash drifts between the quilted beds.

choices.text: Gather glowing shoots (+2 scraps)
Sell lantern soil (+27 gold, -2 scraps)
Close the greenhouse gate (Leave)

events.title: The Ribbon-Shadow Circus
events.description: Rag puppets cast giant shadows against a damask tent while their trailing ribbons stir the candle smoke.

choices.text: Mend the striped marquee (+14 gold)
Buy curtain thread (-20 gold, +3 scraps)
Pass the silent circus (Leave)

events.title: The Velvet Patch Pier
events.description: A lopsided pier creaks under patchwork lanterns, its velvet planks stitched to a swelling ink-black tide.

choices.text: Collect loose hooks (+1 scrap)
Repair the moorings (+23 gold, -1 scrap)
Walk back from the pier (Leave)

events.title: The Lullaby Stitch Chapel
events.description: Tiny thread bells hum under moss-green stitched rafters while wax candles gutter in the draft.

choices.text: Clean the tiny lanterns (+9 gold)
Trade for thread bells (-12 gold, +2 scraps)
Leave the humming chapel (Leave)

events.title: The Silver-Cobble Toll
events.description: Stuffed crows perch on a silver-stitched toll bridge, their brass bells jingling whenever travellers pass.

choices.text: Rewind the bell cord (+2 scraps)
Buy two spools of pass-thread (spend 15 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Take the stitched sidepath (Leave)

events.title: The Amber-Thimble Loom
events.description: A plump ragdoll weaver feeds copper thread through an enormous amber thimble beneath a velvet awning.

choices.text: Repair the thimble loom (spend 2 scraps; gain 32 gold)
Untangle fallen bobbins (+1 scrap)
Leave the loom humming (Leave)

events.title: The Midnight Moth Post
events.description: Button-eyed moth couriers carry sealed plum-velvet letters from a crooked patchwork postbox.

choices.text: Sort the wayward letters (+13 gold)
Buy moth-wing stamps (spend 19 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Let the moths deliver their letters (Leave)

events.title: The Rosequilt Bridgekeeper
events.description: A stitched-X-eyed bridgekeeper polishes rosy brass buttons on a moss-green quilt railing.

choices.text: Barter a spare button (spend 1 scrap; gain 23 gold)
Buy safety pins (spend 12 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Cross without trading (Leave)

events.title: The Starhook Washhouse
events.description: Silver hooks hold dripping star-patterned quilts over a lantern-lit blackwater washhouse.

choices.text: Collect the frayed trim (+2 scraps)
Sell two copper hooks (spend 2 scraps; gain 34 gold)
Leave the quilts to dry (Leave)

events.title: The Bellspool Masquerade
events.description: Round velvet dolls dance beneath hanging bobbin bells, wearing mismatched stitched masks.

choices.text: Sew masks for the dancers (+18 gold)
Buy masque thread (spend 21 gold; gain 4 scraps)
Slip away before the last bell (Leave)

events.title: The Blacklace Marionette Choir
events.description: Round stitched singers hang from velvet cords beneath a bruised-plum stage canopy.

choices.text: Retie the marionettes' cords (spend 2 scraps, earn 33 gold)
Buy a bundle of spare cords (pay 16 gold, gain 3 scraps)
Leave the choir singing (Leave)

events.title: The Copper-Moth Almanac
events.description: A huge button-eyed moth keeps weather maps folded inside its quilted wings.

choices.text: Ink tomorrow's sky (earn 11 gold)
Trade for silk pages (pay 19 gold, gain 3 scraps)
Close the almanac (Leave)

events.title: The Oxblood Pin Bazaar
events.description: A stocky pincushion keeper weighs blunt silver pins under dripping lanterns.

choices.text: Sell recovered pins (spend 3 scraps, gain 42 gold)
Buy a woven pin sheath (pay 12 gold, gain 2 scraps)
Leave the bazaar (Leave)

events.title: The Mossveil Hollow Bridge
events.description: A soft giant with button knuckles keeps a bridge of braided thread from unraveling.

choices.text: Mend the loose braid (earn 2 scraps)
Reclaim old toll buttons (spend 1 scrap, gain 17 gold)
Leave the bridge (Leave)

events.title: The Bone-Cream Lantern Caravan
events.description: Three lantern-dolls carry a moonlit wagon stitched from patterned pillowcases.

choices.text: Guide the wagon past the marsh (gain 15 gold)
Purchase fresh thread wicks (pay 22 gold, gain 4 scraps)
Leave the caravan (Leave)

events.title: The Saffron Button Harvest
events.description: Plump scarecrow dolls gather brass buttons from black velvet pumpkin vines.

choices.text: Thread the baskets (gain 2 scraps)
Trade the button harvest (spend 2 scraps, gain 29 gold)
Leave the harvest (Leave)

events.title: The Nightjar Ribbon Exchange
events.description: A round button-eyed nightjar doll sorts velvet ribbon parcels beneath a saffron lantern and an oxblood quilt awning.

choices.text: Sort the tangled delivery ribbons (gain 2 scraps)
Buy waxproof ribbon bundles (spend 21 gold; gain 4 scraps)
Leave the sleeping ribbon exchange

events.title: The Clockwork Rookery
events.description: Brass-beaked stuffed rooks perch on enormous spool-gears while a plump clockmaker winds their embroidered wings.

choices.text: Repair the rook wings (spend 2 scraps; gain 32 gold)
Buy riveted metal feathers (spend 16 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Let the clockwork rooks rest

events.title: The Cinder-Needle Forge
events.description: A squat soot-grey ragdoll smith hammers bent silver needles on a brass-button anvil lit by a warm red coal.

choices.text: Sort the cold rivets (gain 1 scrap)
Sell a bundle of bent needles (spend 3 scraps; gain 43 gold)
Leave the forge embers glowing

events.title: The Snowquilt Waystation
events.description: A plush doll in a thick midnight-teal quilt coat tends a stitched road sign as bone-cream snow patches cover the path.

choices.text: Guide the lost parcel train (gain 14 gold)
Buy stormproof seam thread (spend 18 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Follow the quiet snow road

events.title: The Ghostlight Parcel Tower
events.description: A rounded lantern-eyed post keeper stacks cloth-wrapped parcels in a leaning plum tower stitched with tiny gold stars.

choices.text: Deliver the lit parcels (gain 11 gold)
Trade wax-stamped parcel seals (spend 2 scraps; gain 36 gold)
Leave the parcel lights burning

events.title: The Lullaby Button Fountain
events.description: Three rosy round ragdolls hum beside a midnight-blue fountain where brass buttons bob in embroidered waves.

choices.text: Collect fallen buttons (gain 2 scraps)
Buy four wish buttons (spend 23 gold; gain 4 scraps)
Leave the fountain to its song

events.title: The Blackwater Singing Well
events.description: A round button-eyed frog sings inside a velvet-lined wishing well; tarnished brass wishes shimmer on its stitches.

choices.text: Polish the well's lost wish-buttons (gain 13 gold)
Buy rainproof well-thread (spend 17 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the frog to its song (Leave)

events.title: The Nightglass Firefly Hutch
events.description: A plump plum-velvet mothkeeper opens a glass hutch of lantern-bright button fireflies beneath a stitched cobalt sky.

choices.text: Reweave the fireflies' torn net (spend 2 scraps; gain 31 gold)
Gather loose glowing trim (gain 1 scrap)
Shut the hutch quietly (Leave)

events.title: The Silver Snail Clocktower
events.description: A squat clockwork snail carries a moonlit clock on its quilted shell, winding it with silver spool antennae.

choices.text: Buy clockthread for the road (spend 19 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Trade a spare spool-gear (spend 1 scrap; gain 22 gold)
Leave the slow clock ticking (Leave)

events.title: The Inkcap Mushroom School
events.description: Button-eyed mushroom pupils practise needlework under a damask leaf canopy while their round teacher rings a thimble bell.

choices.text: Teach the pupils a safe stitch (gain 17 gold)
Donate inkproof patches (spend 2 scraps; gain 37 gold)
Leave the thimble classroom (Leave)

events.title: The Amber Mole Tunnel
events.description: A plump moss-cloth mole with brass-button eyes lifts a copper thimble lantern over a tunnel stitched into the rain-dark road.

choices.text: Gather fallen lamp-wick threads (gain 2 scraps)
Buy the mole's brass tunnel key (spend 17 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Follow the quiet tunnel (Leave)

events.title: The Inkblue Otter Ferry
events.description: A round midnight-teal otter doll steers a boat made from a folded gingham coat, using an enormous silver needle as an oar.

choices.text: Patch the ferry's torn sail (spend 2 scraps; gain 31 gold)
Collect floating coat offcuts (gain 1 scrap)
Leave the ferry at its mooring (Leave)

events.title: The Mossbound Tortoise Library
events.description: A broad button-eyed tortoise carries a tiny velvet library on its quilted shell, each book fastened with crossed stitches.

choices.text: Sort the shell's loose story pages (gain 14 gold)
Buy a needlework bookmark (spend 19 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Let the tortoise keep its stories (Leave)

events.title: The Brass Buttonbear Stormgate
events.description: A stout oxblood bear doll braces a copper gate against a sewn storm, its button paws gripping a massive spool crank.

choices.text: Oil the jammed spool crank (spend 1 scrap; gain 22 gold)
Buy stormproof hem tape (spend 21 gold; gain 4 scraps)
Slip through before the wind returns (Leave)

events.title: The Lantern Snail Posthouse
events.description: A plump moss-felt snail carries a posthouse in its shell, stamping letters with an enormous wax seal beneath a warm thimble lantern.

choices.text: Gather discarded wax-seal thread (gain 2 scraps)
Buy three lantern-wick spools (spend 16 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Let the snail carry the letters into the fog

events.title: The Velvet Fox Thread Trick
events.description: A broad-faced oxblood fox puppet fans giant gingham cards, its long velvet tail stitched into a magician's sleeve hiding a little coin purse.

choices.text: Resew the fox's split card deck (gain 15 gold)
Trade two scrap bundles for the hidden purse (spend 2 scraps; gain 24 gold)
Keep your purse closed and watch the fox bow

events.title: The Copper Beetle Pulley Bridge
events.description: A squat copper-shelled beetle doll winds a rope bridge with enormous brass-buckle mandibles under a midnight-teal lantern.

choices.text: Replace two frayed rope bundles (spend 2 scraps; gain 34 gold)
Buy three buckle-thread offcuts (spend 19 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Cross when the beetle's pulley falls quiet

events.title: The Inkblue Swan Raincloak
events.description: A round inkblue swan ragdoll shelters travellers under one enormous umbrella-shaped quilt wing as brass-button raindrops tick along the hem.

choices.text: Sew the swan's leaky rain hem (gain 2 scraps)
Buy four waterproof thread bundles (spend 21 gold; gain 4 scraps)
Walk beyond the swan's quilted shadow

events.title: The Umbra Zipper Meteor
events.description: A round soot-purple comet doll drags an enormous silver zipper across the night sky, its bright teeth raining onto the torn velvet road.

choices.text: Gather fallen silver zipper teeth (+2 scraps)
Pay 18 gold for the comet's star-thread shuttle (+3 scraps)
Let the comet close the night seam (Leave)

events.title: The Button-Bun Bakery
events.description: A round baker doll with mismatched button eyes pedals giant patchwork bellows, blowing amber light through an oven of knitted button buns.

choices.text: Repair the torn oven bellows (spend 2 scraps; gain 29 gold)
Collect dropped oven twine (+1 scrap)
Leave the button buns warming (Leave)

events.title: The Moth-Needle Weather Vane
events.description: An enormous moth-shaped brass vane with sewing-needle antennae creaks above a plum quilt watchhouse, pointing at a shower of silver pins.

choices.text: Sew down the loose vane (spend 1 scrap; gain 20 gold)
Buy two coils of storm yarn (spend 16 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Let the moth vane turn with the wind (Leave)

events.title: The Clockwork Teacup Parade
events.description: Three button-eyed teacup automata march on oversized brass-spoon legs, spilling glowing thread from their lids onto a cobbled patchwork path.

choices.text: Collect the spilled glowing thread (+2 scraps)
Polish the parade's spoon joints (spend 2 scraps; gain 25 gold)
Watch the last teacup march away (Leave)

events.title: The Ironboot Badger
events.description: A barrel-shaped oxblood badger doll punches an enormous copper awl through a velvet boot bigger than its body; two mismatched button eyes gleam in lanternlight.

choices.text: Sell two scrap bundles of boot hems (spend 2 scraps; gain 32 gold)
Buy spare copper awls (spend 15 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the cobbler to its hammering

events.title: The Midnight Seahorse Lockgate
events.description: A plump midnight-teal seahorse puppet winds its corkscrew tail around an oversized brass canal key; an amber lantern glows inside the quilted lock gate.

choices.text: Turn the old gate wheel (spend 1 scrap; gain 23 gold)
Buy new key-thread (spend 20 gold; gain 4 scraps)
Leave the gate to the tide

events.title: The Fireglass Salamander
events.description: A round moss-cloth salamander with stitched-X eyes puffs a glowing amber glass button into a thimble mould; its oversized bellows flap like quilted wings.

choices.text: Sell cooled button glass (spend 3 scraps; gain 39 gold)
Buy fireglass filament (spend 18 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Let the bellows cool

events.title: The Moonkite Hare
events.description: A squat bone-cream hare ragdoll braces an enormous plum-gingham kite against the wind; four brass-button tails tap on the moonlit crossroads.

choices.text: Repair the four kite tails (spend 2 scraps; gain 29 gold)
Buy windproof kite seams (spend 16 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Wave goodbye to the moonkite

events.title: The Copper Crab's Shears Cart
events.description: A stout oxblood crab ragdoll spreads enormous silver shears over a lace-lined cart; mismatched buttons glimmer on its quilted pincers by candlelight.

choices.text: Sell two spools of scissor offcuts (spend 2 scraps; gain 32 gold)
Buy the crab's stormproof silk hem (spend 21 gold; gain 4 scraps)
Let the crab fold its silver shears

events.title: The Mourning-Clock Armadillo
events.description: A squat midnight-teal armadillo curls around an enormous cracked bone-cream clock; four brass-button paws rewind its long thread hour hand.

choices.text: Rewind the clock with a spool (spend 1 scrap; gain 18 gold)
Buy a spring-thread winding (spend 17 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Let the thread clock tick in the fog

events.title: The Blacklace Puffin Ferry
events.description: A round bone-cream puffin doll in a plum patchwork cape paddles a tiny black-lace ferry with an oversized red knitting needle beneath an amber locklight.

choices.text: Mend the huge needle-oar (spend 2 scraps; gain 28 gold)
Buy canal-warmed wool (spend 12 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Watch the puffin ferry slip into the mist

events.title: The Thimbleback Beaver Dam
events.description: A plump moss-cloth beaver ragdoll stacks giant quilted log patches into a little canal dam; a silver thimble caps one tooth and button eyes catch the lantern glow.

choices.text: Gather abandoned dam offcuts (gain 1 scrap)
Reinforce the giant button sluice (spend 3 scraps; gain 42 gold)
Leave the beaver to its midnight repairs
